programs.title: The Grinch
programs.desc: The only companion of the lonely and malicious Grinch is the dog Max. The green creature only leaves the cave in search of food.Meanwhile, the residents of Whosiów are eagerly awaiting a special time of the year, Christmas.Wanting to keep the peace, the Grinch plans to spoil the grand celebrations and kidnap Santa Claus.At the same time, Cindy-Lou and her friends intend to capture a Lappish benefactor to thank him for helping the girl's busy mother.Two opposing intentions will face an inevitable confrontation.Another film adaptation of the adventures of a character created by a children's book writer, Dr.Seuss.Previously, Jim Carrey played the green creature in the 2000 film "The Grinch: No Christmas."In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Jarosław Boberek, Lila Wassermann, Ewa Prus and Karol Kwiatkowski.The carol was performed by Katarzyna Owczarz, Małgorzata Szymańska, Adam Krylik and Krzysztof Pietrzak.

programs.title: Little women
programs.desc: The times of the Civil War.In the absence of their father, who is serving in the military away from the family, the four March sisters from Orchard House are cared for by their mother alone.Marmee wants them to find their own path and helps them enter adulthood.Each of them has a different personality.The oldest Meg dreams of becoming an actress.Family-oriented and warm, Beth has a talent for playing the piano.Jo, an aspiring writer, pursues her goal with her characteristic energy and tenacity.Amy, a bit smart, wants to become a painter.Despite their own problems, the girls are not indifferent to other people's suffering.Young women will get to know the taste of first loves and disappointments.Fate subjects them to tests, after which their lives will never be the same again.

programs.title: BlacKkKlansman
programs.desc: Early 1970s, Colorado Springs, Colorado.Ron Stallworth (John David Washington) becomes the first black police officer in the department.After encountering manifestations of racism, he asks to be transferred to undercover work.He decides to infiltrate the Ku Klux Klan, but for this he will need the help of an older, white colleague - Flip Zimmerman (Adam Driver).Ron calls representatives of a racist militia on the phone, and Flip meets with them directly.The police obtain information about the Klan's planned attack.Ron contacts David Duke (Topher Grace), the Grand Wizard of the Ku Klux Klan, by phone.Soon, Flip is accepted into the organization.Spike Lee's film won an Oscar for best adapted screenplay in 2019.Starring: versatile supporting actor Adam Driver ("What's Up, Davis?", "Silence") and former American football player John David Washington, Denzel Washington's son, nominated for a Golden Globe for this role.

programs.title: Veep 4
programs.desc: The story of Vice President Selina Meyer (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) continues, as she and her colleagues want to achieve something significant in politics.The woman avoids deals, scandals and corruption.She is assisted in her daily work by Amy, her office manager (Anna Chlumsky), spokesman Mike McLintock (Matt Walsh), general counsel Gary (Tony Hale) and secretary Sue (Sufe Bradshaw).The entire team must contend with the ambitious Dan Egan (Reid Scott) and the confident White House employee Jonah Ryan (Timothy Simons).

programs.title: Wunderschöner
programs.desc: 50-year-old Nadine (Anneke Kim Sarnau) does everything to look young.When she discovers that her husband (Godehard Giese) is cheating on her, she falls into depression.The couple's daughter Lilly (Emilia Packard) is interested in the classes lectured by feminist Vicky (Nora Tschirner).Enno, the narrator's boyfriend, participates in the project of her new colleague Trevor (Malick Bauer).He doesn't know that his beloved will soon lose her head for him.Julie (Emilia Schüle), a new TV production manager, suffers from loneliness.Her difficult relationship with her co-worker increases her doubts about herself.Sonja (Karoline Herfurth) and Milan (Friedrich Mücke) go to family therapy.When it comes to light that the man has a new partner, the woman starts dating.
